newsitem.title: SPAIN: Police arrest Basque leaders over illegal protest.
newsitem.headline: Police arrest Basque leaders over illegal protest.

text.p: Police arrested two leaders of the political arm of Basque separatist movement ETA on Wednesday for failing to appear in court to testify about an illegal demonstration, the Basque interior ministry said.

A Basque court wants Rufi Etxeberria and Jon Idigoras to testify about a radical nationalist Herri Batasuna (Popular Unity) protest timed to clash with a demonstration in favour of local police, following the killing of two police officers by a separatist.
The Basque interior ministry had expressly banned the nationalist march on December 14.
Members of Herri Batasuna routinely disregard court instructions as part of their refusal to "recognise the legitimacy of the Spanish state".

Idigoras, the group's main spokesman, was held in jail in February on charges of collaborating with an armed group after showing a banned election campaign video featuring armed and hooded members of ETA (Basque Homeland and Freedom).
ETA has killed some 800 people since 1968 in its campaign for an independent Basque state.
